options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: Endpoint of the Infrahub API, optional env=INFRAHUB_ADDRESS

options.name: artifact_id
options.description: UUID of the artifact (mutually exclusive with artifact_name)

options.name: artifact_name
options.description: Name of the artifact (mutually exclusive with artifact_id)

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch in which the request is made

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: target_id
options.description: UUID of the target node (e.g., device ID) that the artifact is associated with

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for Infrahub requests in seconds

options.name: token
options.description: The API token created through Infrahub, optional env=INFRAHUB_API_TOKEN

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL of the Infrahub instance
